address: 25 The Coombe, Dublin City, D08 YV07, Ireland
bio: Set in a historic area of this city is this fittingly traditional-looking Irish pub, where the charming staff offer a warm and friendly welcome. It’s deservedly busy – drinkers are welcome but most are here for the food. Enticing dishes are fresh, flavoursome and great value, with the likes of oxtail and bone marrow Parker House rolls....
